title: 第4章 不速之客
content_zh:
第4章 不速之客
转身的一瞬，许青飞速扫过身后。
他看到七八丈外，有七个人在不同的位置，星散的向自己靠近。
这七人都是成年，有男有女，衣着以皮袄为主，颜色深灰，挂着很多皮袋。
每个人身上都有兵器，各自分散。
其中三人持弓、二人拿刀，彼此都不把后背留给对方，似有防备的样子。
还有一人手上戴着拳套，独自前行，所在位置是最中间。
至于方才语气阴阳怪调者，则是一个身体高大的壮汉。
此人扛着一把巨大的战斧，距离许青也是最近。
他身体极为魁梧，脸上有一道狰狞的疤痕，且长满了胡子，此刻目中带着残忍，狞笑间迈着大步，逼近许青。
这一切，都是许青一眼扫过后所看。
他瞳孔收缩，脑海瞬间分析出这些人彼此不像是一个整体，更像是临时组队。
这一点是从他们的站位以及有所防备可以清晰看出。
且这些人的身份，许青也已然猜到，他们……都是拾荒者！
南凰洲不缺少拾荒者，他们大都凶残且没有太多底线可讲，一切都是赤裸裸的弱肉强食。
显然这一次禁区血雨停下，结界
对他们而言，禁区虽危险，可本就是在刀尖生存之人，空城中所蕴含的资源，足以让他们红眼。
即便物资大都被污染，但也还是有具备价值之物。
心中思绪飞速转动中，许青身体一晃，就要从一侧跃走。
但那向他逼近的大汉，眼看许青要跑，目中凶残之意更浓，狞笑里带着嗜血。

“想跑？我最喜欢虐杀你这种小崽子了，你那皮袋里的物品应该不少吧，雷队，这小子，给我吧。”
大汉目中的残忍，仿佛可以从其瞳孔内散出，形成威慑，配合其高大的身躯以及战斧，压迫感极大。
此刻大步冲来，右手战斧更是抡起，向着许青欲跃去的方向，直接扔去。
呼的一下，战斧带着啸声，划破双方之间的距离，从半空瞬息临近。
大汉力气很大，动作也不慢，但许青的速度更快，几乎在这战斧到来的刹那，他身体猛地加速向旁避开。
战斧在他面前，呼啸而过。
掀起的风刮在许青脸上，将其散乱的头发吹起了一些，露出了头发下，冷厉如狼的双目。
下一瞬，许青身体顺势在地上一个翻滚，没有逃走，而是到了大汉的近前，右手抬起，一根乌黑色的铁签直接出现在他手中。
借助身高不如对方的优势，许青整个人向上猛地一跃，手中的铁签从下至上，冲着大汉下巴刺去！
这一切太快，许青瘦小的身体，以及之前欲逃走的举动，都为他的出手形成了天然的掩饰，以至于大汉也都在这一瞬有了生死危机之感。
但他毕竟经验丰富，此刻面色大变中上半身猛地向后仰去，险之又险的避开铁签，但下巴上还是被划出了一道血痕。
可不等他内心怒意焚烧，许青神色冷漠，一击不中左手快速从小腿处抽出匕首。
在这大汉上半身向后仰去时，直接低身顺势将匕首，狠狠的刺入大汉的右脚脚背。
噗的一声，这匕首穿透草鞋，穿透血肉，直接钉入泥土中！
大汉神色扭曲，剧烈的疼痛袭卷全身，凄厉的惨叫蓦然传出，刚要反击，但许青太过灵活，出手后身体激射倒退一处断壁掩体旁，整个人蹲在那里，蓄势待发。
摇晃的火光遮在他的脸上，使他整个人看起来有些明暗不定，但那如狼一样的眼神，是火光所无法遮掩，带着警惕与凶狠，看向那些拾荒者。
这一切发生的太快，许青的年纪与形体又具备迷惑性，以至于拾荒者里不少人大意下，没有立刻反应过来。
此刻纷纷目露凶芒，开弓的三人更是眼神刹那锐利。
躲在掩体后的许青，没有去看不远处惨叫凄厉，挣扎中抽出脚背匕首的大汉，而是扫过三个持弓者后，最终看向站在正中间位置的那个带着拳套之人。
此人是个老者，衣着虽与其他人类似，但目光却是最为犀利，且在他身上，许青隐隐感受到了灵能隐晦的波动。

更是从其所处位置，以及四周其他人本能的目光汇聚上，许青心中多少有了判断。
对方……应该是这些拾荒者的临时头领。
许青看着老者，心底分析，而老者也在看着他，眼神内似有一些奇异。
很快老者挪开目光，望着不远处那团还在升腾的焚化火焰，有所沉默。
此刻，那拔出了匕首的大汉，眼睛里有怒火狂暴，整个人发出一声咆哮，向着许青就要冲去。
“小崽子，看我怎么弄死你！”
许青眼睛眯起，露出凌厉之芒，刚要有所举动，可就在这时，一个苍老的声音，平静的传来。
“够了！”
这两个字，似具备了震慑，使得那咆哮的大汉不得不停下脚步，回头看向说话之人。
说话的，正是许青方才所望的那个带着拳套的老者。
“雷队……”
“这小孩应该是外面贫民窟的幸存者，神灵都对其网开一面，你就不要出手了，我们走。”
“可是……”大汉眼睛里有着强烈的不甘，他相信自己之前只是大意，若真的出手，他有把握几个呼吸内，就捏碎许青的脖子。
于是刚要开口，老者淡淡的看了他一眼。
“还要我说第二遍么？”
大汉神色内有挣扎，但最终还是低下了头。
只是低头时，他余光看向躲藏在掩体处的许青，杀机在脸上一闪而过，随后面色阴冷的转身，一瘸一拐的走向老者那里。
这杀机，许青感受到了，眼睛微微眯了起来，警惕的望着这群拾荒者，逐渐走远。
可就在他们走出数十丈远后，中间的老者脚步一顿，转过头，不知是看许青，还是在看那堆火化尸体燃烧的热焰，半晌后忽然开口。
“小孩，愿意跟我离开这里么？”

许青一愣，他注意到对方的话语里，说的是我，而不是我们。
于是他沉默下来，目光在这群人中扫过，而那老者也有耐心，没有催促，站在远处等待答案。
直至十多息后，许青多次扫过这些人，看了看老者，又看了看被自己所伤，面色阴冷的大汉。
少年眼睛里有奇异之芒一闪而逝。
他慢慢站起了身，没有说话，缓缓向他们靠近。
眼看许青走来，老者笑了笑，转身继续前行，其他人也都深深看了许青一眼，随之走去。
就这样，许青跟随着这群拾荒者，看着他们在城池内搜寻具有价值之物。
期间他知道了那狰狞大汉的外号，旁人称呼他残牛。
此人也多次扫过许青，目中都有阴冷之芒。
但显然是克制着，似乎他并不着急，要等阻止他出手的老者不在的机会。
而他仿佛也很笃定，这样的机会，未来的路上一定会有。
许青思索了一下，想到那大汉的贪婪，于是凭着对城池的熟悉，他给予了这些拾荒者一些帮助。
许青的姿态很低，使这些拾荒者寻找有价值之物的速度更快，找到的物品也更多。
而残牛明显贪婪，即便是身上无法容纳，超过自身负重，但也还是想要拿走更多。
于是，本就带伤的他，搜寻的范围比其他人更多，背着的物品也就更重。
一开始还不算什么，但随着时间的流逝，大汉体力明显被大量耗费，疲惫感也远远超过所有人。
至于城主府的区域，许青考虑那被称为雷队的老者，对自己有帮助，所以没有将他们引去。
直至夜晚快要降临时，一行人终于离开城池，在城外曾经的贫民窟内扎营。
他们的动作很娴熟，扎了六个帐篷。
除了那持刀的二人一个帐篷外，其他都是单独，更是在帐篷外点起了燃香，还有人拿出一些粉末，绕着四周洒了一圈。

眼看天色愈黑，城池内各种嘶吼开始回荡，这些拾荒者都走入帐篷内。
唯有雷队扫了眼孤零零的许青，从一旁取出一个睡袋，扔了过去。
“燃香可以驱散异兽，粉末可以避开诡异，以你今天的贡献，有我在，残牛也不敢打你注意，这里还算安全。”
说完，老者不再理会，走入帐篷中。
许青没说话，只是深深的看了眼老者的帐篷，捡起睡袋
但却没有封死，而是对着拾荒者帐篷的方向，留下一道缝。
深夜，外界的嘶吼与凄厉之音，越发强烈，诡异的哭声也缥缈回旋，可怖的气氛仿佛在外界无处不在。
似乎没有人愿意在这个时候，离开庇护的居所。
唯独许青……
他在睡袋内睁开了眼，一动不动，默默等待。
直至时间流逝，到了深夜中人们最为熟睡的时间段，许青慢慢的从睡袋内爬了出来。
他的动作很小心，尽可能的不发出任何声响。
城池内的嘶吼与凄厉，在他的耳边回荡，但却没有分去他丝毫的心神。
小心的爬出后，许青默默走向大汉残牛所在的帐篷。
他不允许身边有威胁到自身生命的隐患，哪怕只是隐患，他也要想办法立刻将其解决掉。
这是许青在贫民窟生存下来，以血的教训学到的法则。也是他此番之所以同意跟随的原因。
甚至白天时他提示众人，使他们收获更大，也都是看出残牛的贪婪，欲让其带伤的情况下越发疲惫，从而失去警惕。
而他故意放低姿态的做法，也是为了麻痹对方，使其疏于防范。
这一切，都是为了如今的出手，此刻许青神色平静，轻轻的靠近了帐篷，没有轻举妄动，而是先蹲在那里，仔细听了半晌。
传入耳中的呼噜声均匀，持续稳定，不似作假，确定了这些后，许青眯着眼，慢慢抽出自己的铁签，轻轻划开了帐篷的扣子，缓缓的钻了进去。

帐篷内昏暗，许青模糊的看到躺在那里的残牛，睡得很沉，显然是在白天的负荷，再加上受了伤，使其疲惫无比。
且强者的心态，也使残牛无论如何也想不到，白天有着讨好配合姿态的少年，会于其他拾荒者都在的情况下，半夜冒险到来。
所以此刻，他并不知道，自己的帐篷内，有了不速之客。
许青看着熟睡的残牛，冷冷的目光平静如深海，轻轻的靠近，直至站在他的旁边后，许青没有丝毫拖沓，右手匕首寒芒一闪，瞬间在茫然不知的残牛脖子上，狠狠一割。
力度极大，险些尸首分离。
鲜血刹那喷涌。
剧痛使得残牛眼睛猛地睁开，看到了许青面无表情的脸，神色露出无法置信与惊恐，刚要挣扎，但许青左手已飞快抬起，一把按在他的嘴上，使其无法发出半点声响。
而挣扎，在这一刻越发强烈，残牛眼睛睁大，全身疯狂抽搐。
但许青的手似铁钳一样，按的死死，右脚更是抬起，直接踏在残牛的肚子上，自身化作了弓形，借助稳定的力道，使残牛的挣扎于事无补。
随着鲜血不断地涌出，残牛就好似一条离开了水中的鱼，慢慢绝望之意在其目中强烈的浮现，甚至都露出了哀求。
但他看到的，依旧是许青平静的面孔，至于他身体挣扎弄出的声响，也在外界的嘶吼以及凄厉之鸣中，被掩盖下去，传不出丝毫。
时间慢慢流逝，直至十几息后，残牛的挣扎渐渐微弱，最终颤抖了一下，整个人松弛下来，一动不动，唯有睁着的眼，残留死亡前的恐惧，气绝身亡。
许青没有立刻抬手，而是又等了一会，确定对方真的死亡，这才松开手，擦去上面的血迹后，他
从里面将麻布包裹的蛇头谨慎的拿出，小心翼翼的用蛇头的毒牙，戳破了残牛的皮肤。
下一瞬，随着毒素的蔓延，残牛的尸体泛起阵阵绿色的气泡，慢慢的融化。
一炷香后，尸体彻底化作一摊血水，渗入地面泥土里。
许青默默看着这一切，开始整理现场，又将残牛的遗物处理，作出对方失踪的假象，这才钻出了帐篷。
冷风迎面吹来，带走了一些沾染在他身上的血腥味，许青抬头看着黑夜，深吸一口冰寒的空气，缓步回到自己的睡袋内。
躺在睡袋的一刻，他的心底终于踏实下来，隐患被驱除所带来的安全感，让他闭上双眼，很快睡着，但手里的铁签，却始终紧握，不曾松开丝毫。
一夜无话。

第二天清晨，晨曦洒落，映照大地，许青睁开了眼，安静的爬出睡袋，目光似随意的扫向残牛所在的帐篷。
下一瞬，他眼睛微微收缩。
残牛的帐篷，居然消失了。
许青内心一沉，更为警惕。
很快其他拾荒者也在清晨中陆续走出帐篷，第一时间发现了此事，纷纷诧异，也有人四下寻找未果。
但因残牛消失的彻底，就连帐篷也都没了，所以有人判断，对方应该是贪婪城内之物半夜离去，又或者是其他原因，不告而别。
总之在这禁区内，太多的原因会让一个人消失了。
本就是临时组成的团队，残牛又是独自一人，所以很快这些拾荒者就不再关注此事，也有人看向许青，可似乎觉得这件事不可能与许青有关，再加上没有调查的义务，于是收回猜测。
唯独那被称为雷队的老者，收回许青的睡袋时，大有深意的看了他一眼，淡淡开口。
“现在，还跟我走吗？”
这句话，意义深远，许青沉默。
老者也没再说什么，呼喊众人，在这初阳下赶路。
许青站在原地呆了一下，本能的回过头看向废墟城池。最终转头，望着老者的背影，想了想后，他迈步跟随，走着走着，步履渐渐坚定了一些。
六个拾荒者，一个小孩，他们的身影在阳光下，被拉的很长……
远远的，有风吹过，将他们前行时的唏嘘与感慨，飘散开来。
“这就是神灵浩劫，全城灭亡。”
“这世上的禁区，又多了一个……”
“这还不算什么，你们听说过吧，七八年前在北部区域有一个大城，神灵睁眼看去，那片区域连同城池直接就诡异的消失了，仿佛从没有存在过。”
对话声越来越微弱，初阳下，远行的身影里，少年沉默，默默的听，默默的走。
越走，越远。

作为一个小萌新，忐忑发布了粉嫩新书，兄弟姐妹，多多关照，求
(本章完)

Chapter 4 Uninvited Guests
The moment he turned around, Xu Qing quickly swept behind him.
He saw seven or eight feet away, seven people in different positions, scattered towards him.
These seven people are all adults, both male and female. Their clothes are mainly fur coats, dark gray in color, with many leather bags hanging on them.
Everyone has weapons on them and they are scattered.
Three of them held bows and two held swords. Neither of them left their backs to the other, as if they were on guard.
There is another person wearing boxing gloves on his hands, walking alone, and his position is in the middle.
As for the person who spoke in a strange tone just now, he was a tall and strong man.
This man was carrying a huge battle ax and was the closest to Xu Qing.
He was extremely burly, had a ferocious scar on his face, and was covered with beard. He had a cruel look in his eyes at the moment, and he took long strides towards Xu Qing with a ferocious smile.
All of this was what Xu Qing saw after taking a quick glance.
His pupils shrank, and his mind instantly analyzed that these people did not look like a whole, but more like a temporary team.
This can be clearly seen from their positioning and precautions.
And Xu Qing had already guessed the identities of these people. They... were all scavengers!
There is no shortage of scavengers in Nanhuang Continent. Most of them are cruel and have no bottom line. They are all naked predators of the weak.
Obviously this time the blood rain in the restricted area stopped, and the barrier
For them, although the restricted area is dangerous, they are people who survive on the edge of a knife. The resources contained in the empty city are enough to make them red-eyed.
Even if most of the materials are contaminated, there are still things of value.
Thoughts in his heart were spinning rapidly, Xu Qing's body swayed and he was about to jump away from the side.
But the big man approaching him saw that Xu Qing was about to run away, his eyes became more ferocious, and his smile was filled with bloodlust.
"Want to run away? I like to torture and kill brats like you the most. There should be a lot of items in your leather bag. Lei Captain, give this kid to me."
The cruelty in the big man's eyes seemed to emanate from his pupils, forming a deterrent. Combined with his tall body and battle ax, he felt extremely oppressive.
At this moment, he strode forward, swung the battle ax in his right hand, and threw it directly in the direction Xu Qing was about to jump.
With a roar, the tomahawk roared, piercing the distance between the two sides, and approached from mid-air.
The big man was very strong and his movements were not slow, but Xu Qing was faster. Almost at the moment when the battle ax arrived, his body suddenly accelerated to avoid it.
The battle ax whizzed past him.
The rising wind blew on Xu Qing's face, blowing some of his scattered hair, revealing his cold and wolf-like eyes under the hair.
The next moment, Xu Qing's body rolled on the ground. Instead of escaping, he came close to the big man, raised his right hand, and a black iron stick appeared directly in his hand.
Taking advantage of his lower height than his opponent, Xu Qing jumped upwards and stabbed the big man's chin with the iron stick in his hand from bottom to top!
All this happened so fast. Xu Qing's thin body and previous attempts to escape formed a natural cover for his attack, so that the big man also felt a life-or-death crisis at this moment.
But after all, he was rich in experience. At this moment, his expression changed drastically, and his upper body suddenly leaned back. He narrowly avoided the iron sign, but there was still a blood mark on his chin.
But before the anger in his heart burned, Xu Qing looked indifferent and quickly pulled out the dagger from his calf with his left hand without hitting the target.
When the big man leaned his upper body back, he lowered his body and stabbed the dagger hard into the instep of the big man's right foot.
With a pop, the dagger penetrated the straw sandals, penetrated flesh and blood, and was nailed directly into the soil!
The big man's expression was distorted, severe pain swept over his body, and a shrill scream suddenly came out. He was about to fight back, but Xu Qing was too flexible. After taking action, his body shot backwards and fell back to a broken wall bunker. He squatted there, ready to attack.
The swaying firelight covered his face, making him seeIt looked a little uncertain, but the wolf-like eyes couldn't be concealed by the fire. They looked at the scavengers with vigilance and ferocity.
All this happened so quickly, and Xu Qing's age and body shape were so confusing that many of the scavengers were careless and did not react immediately.
At this moment, their eyes all showed fierce looks, and the eyes of the three people who were shooting their bows were even sharper.
Xu Qing, who was hiding behind the bunker, did not look at the big man who was screaming miserably not far away and struggling to pull out the dagger from his instep. Instead, he glanced at the three bow holders and finally looked at the man with fists standing in the middle.
This man was an old man. Although his clothes were similar to the others, his eyes were the sharpest. Xu Qing could faintly feel the subtle fluctuations of spiritual energy in him.
Based on his position and the instinctive gazes of others around him, Xu Qing had some judgment in his mind.
The other party...should be the temporary leader of these scavengers.
Xu Qing looked at the old man, analyzing in his heart, and the old man was also looking at him, with something strange in his eyes.
Soon the old man looked away and looked at the rising incineration flame not far away, feeling silent.
At this moment, the big man who had pulled out the dagger had furious eyes, and he let out a roar and rushed towards Xu Qing.
"Baby, let's see how I kill you!"
Xu Qing's eyes narrowed with a sharp look, and he was about to make a move, but at this moment, an old voice came calmly.
"Enough!"
These two words seemed to be so intimidating that the roaring man had to stop and look back at the speaker.
The one who spoke was the old man with boxing gloves that Xu Qing had just looked at.
"Thunder Team..."
"This kid should be a survivor from the slums outside. Even the gods have spared him. Please don't take action. Let's go."
"But..." There was a strong unwillingness in the big man's eyes. He believed that he was just careless before. If he really took action, he was sure to crush Xu Qing's neck within a few breaths.
So just as he was about to speak, the old man gave him a faint look.
"Do you want me to say it a second time?"
The big man looked struggling, but finally lowered his head.
Just when he lowered his head, he looked at Xu Qing hiding in the bunker out of the corner of his eye. Murderous intent flashed across his face, then he turned around with a cold expression and limped towards the old man.
Xu Qing felt this murderous intention, and narrowed his eyes slightly, watching the group of scavengers warily as they gradually walked away.
But just after they walked dozens of feet away, the old man in the middle paused and turned his head. Whether he was looking at Xu Qing or the hot flames of the pile of cremated corpses, he suddenly spoke after a while.
"Kid, are you willing to leave here with me?"
Xu Qing was stunned. He noticed that the other person's words were talking about me, not us.
So he fell silent and glanced across the group of people. The old man was also patient and did not rush. He stood in the distance and waited for the answer.
After more than ten breaths, Xu Qing glanced at these people many times, looked at the old man, and then looked at the big man who was injured by himself and had a cold expression.
There was a strange light in the young man's eyes.
He stood up slowly, without speaking, and slowly approached them.
Seeing Xu Qing approaching, the old man smiled, turned around and continued walking. The others also looked at Xu Qing deeply and walked away.
In this way, Xu Qing followed this group of scavengers and watched them search for valuable objects in the city.
During this period, he learned the nickname of the ferocious man, and others called him Can Niu.
This person also glanced at Xu Qing many times, with a cold light in his eyes.
But he was obviously restrained, as if he was not in a hurry, waiting for the opportunity when the old man who stopped him from taking action was not around.
And he seemed to be very sure that such an opportunity would definitely come along the way in the future.
Xu Qing thought for a while and thought of the greed of the big man, so based on his familiarity with the city, he gaveGot some help from these scavengers.
Xu Qing's low profile allowed these scavengers to search for valuable things faster and find more items.
The mutilated cow is obviously greedy. Even if it cannot hold it and exceeds its own load, it still wants to take more.
Therefore, he, who was already injured, searched in a wider area than others and carried heavier items.
It was nothing at first, but as time went by, the big man's physical strength was obviously consumed a lot, and his fatigue far exceeded that of everyone else.
As for the area of ​​the City Lord's Mansion, Xu Qing considered that the old man known as Lei Dui would be helpful to him, so he did not lure them there.
Until night was about to fall, the group finally left the city and camped in the former slums outside the city.
They moved very skillfully and pitched six tents.
Except for the two men holding knives in a tent, everyone else was alone. They even lit incense outside the tent, and someone took out some powder and sprinkled it around.
Seeing that the sky was getting darker, various roars began to echo in the city, and these scavengers all walked into the tent.
Only Captain Lei glanced at the lonely Xu Qing, took out a sleeping bag from the side, and threw it over.
"Burning incense can drive away strange beasts, and powder can ward off strange things. With your contribution today, with me here, Can Niu won't dare to call your attention. It's quite safe here."
After saying that, the old man ignored him and walked into the tent.
Xu Qing didn't say anything, but took a deep look at the old man's tent and picked up the sleeping bag.
But instead of sealing it, a crack was left facing the direction of the scavenger's tent.
Late at night, the roars and shrill sounds from the outside world became more and more intense, the weird cries also swirled vaguely, and the terrifying atmosphere seemed to be everywhere in the outside world.
No one seemed willing to leave their sheltered residence at this time.
Only Xu Qing...
He opened his eyes in the sleeping bag and remained motionless, waiting silently.
Until time passed and it was late at night when people were most asleep, Xu Qing slowly crawled out of the sleeping bag.
He moved very carefully, making as little noise as possible.
The roars and screams in the city echoed in his ears, but they did not distract him at all.
After carefully climbing out, Xu Qing silently walked towards the tent where the big man's broken cow was.
He does not allow hidden dangers that threaten his life around him. Even if it is just a hidden danger, he must find a way to solve it immediately.
This is the rule Xu Qing learned through bloody lessons after surviving in the slums. This is also the reason why he agreed to follow him this time.
Even during the day, he reminded everyone so that they could gain more, but he saw the greed of the mutilated cow and wanted to make it more tired even though it was injured, thus losing vigilance.
And he deliberately lowered his posture in order to paralyze the opponent and make him lose guard.
All of this was for the current move. At this moment, Xu Qing looked calm and gently approached the tent. He did not move rashly, but squatted there and listened carefully for a long time.
The snoring that reached his ears was even and steady, not like a fake. After confirming this, Xu Qing squinted, slowly pulled out his iron stick, gently opened the button of the tent, and slowly got in.
It was dark inside the tent, and Xu Qing vaguely saw the broken cow lying there, sleeping deeply. It was obvious that he was extremely tired from the load during the day and the injuries.
Moreover, with his strong mentality, Can Niu could never imagine that a young man who had a flattering and cooperative attitude during the day would venture there in the middle of the night when other scavengers were around.
So at this moment, he didn't know that there was an uninvited guest in his tent.
Xu Qing looked at the sleeping Can Niu with cold eyes as calm as the deep sea. He approached gently until he stood next to him. Xu Qing did not hesitate at all. The cold light of the dagger in his right hand flashed, and he cut the unconscious Can Niu hard on his neck in an instant.
The force was so great that the body was almost separated.Blood spurted out instantly.
The severe pain caused Can Niu's eyes to open suddenly, and he saw Xu Qing's expressionless face, with an expression of disbelief and horror. He was about to struggle, but Xu Qing's left hand quickly raised and pressed on his mouth, making it unable to make any sound.
The struggle became more intense at this moment. Can Niu's eyes widened and his whole body twitched crazily.
But Xu Qing's hands were like iron pliers, pressing tightly, and he raised his right foot and stepped directly on the belly of the crippled cow. He turned into a bow shape, and with the help of stable force, the struggling of the crippled cow was useless.
As the blood continued to gush out, the crippled cow was like a fish out of the water. Slowly, despair emerged strongly in its eyes, and it even appeared to be pleading.
But what he saw was still Xu Qing's calm face. As for the sound of his body struggling, it was also covered up by the roars and screams of the outside world, and could not be heard at all.
Time passed slowly, until more than ten breaths later, Can Niu's struggle gradually became weak, and finally he trembled, and his whole body relaxed and became motionless. Only his eyes were open, remaining the fear before death, and he died.
Xu Qing did not raise his hand immediately, but waited for a while to confirm that the other party was really dead. Then he let go of his hand and wiped off the blood on it.
Carefully take out the snake head wrapped in linen from inside, and carefully use the fangs of the snake head to pierce the skin of the mutilated cow.
The next moment, as the poison spread, bursts of green bubbles appeared on the corpse of the mutilated cow, and it slowly melted.
After burning the incense, the body completely turned into a pool of blood, seeping into the soil on the ground.
Xu Qing watched all this silently, began to clean up the scene, and disposed of the remains of the mutilated cow, pretending that the other party was missing, and then got out of the tent.
The cold wind blew in his face, taking away some of the smell of blood on his body. Xu Qing looked up at the night, took a deep breath of the cold air, and slowly returned to his sleeping bag.
The moment he lay in the sleeping bag, he finally felt at ease in his heart. The sense of security brought by the elimination of hidden dangers made him close his eyes and quickly fell asleep. However, he always held the iron sign in his hand tightly and never let go.
A night of silence.
Early the next morning, the morning light fell and reflected the earth. Xu Qing opened his eyes, climbed out of the sleeping bag quietly, and glanced at the tent where the broken cow was located as if at random.
The next moment, his eyes narrowed slightly.
The crippled cow's tent actually disappeared.
Xu Qing's heart sank and she became more vigilant.
Soon other scavengers also came out of the tent one after another in the early morning. They discovered this immediately and were surprised. Some of them looked around to no avail.
But because the mutilated cow disappeared completely, even the tent was gone, so some people judged that the other party should have left in the middle of the night because he was greedy for the things in the city, or for other reasons, he left without saying goodbye.
In short, in this restricted area, there are too many reasons for a person to disappear.
This was a temporary team, and Can Niu was alone, so these scavengers soon stopped paying attention to the matter. Some people looked at Xu Qing, but they seemed to think that this matter could not be related to Xu Qing, and they had no obligation to investigate, so they withdrew their speculations.
Only the old man known as Captain Lei looked at Xu Qing meaningfully and spoke calmly when he took back Xu Qing's sleeping bag.
"Now, are you still coming with me?"
This sentence was of far-reaching significance, and Xu Qing was silent.
The old man said nothing more and called to everyone to hurry up under the early sunshine.
Xu Qing stood there for a moment and instinctively turned back to look at the ruined city. Finally, he turned around and looked at the old man's back. After thinking about it, he followed him step by step. As he walked, his steps gradually became firmer.
Six scavengers and one child, their figures were stretched very long in the sun...
In the distance, the wind blew by, scattering their sighs and emotions as they moved forward.
"This is a divine catastrophe, and the whole city is destroyed."
"There is another forbidden zone in this world..."
"This is not yetWhat the hell, have you heard about it? Seven or eight years ago, there was a big city in the northern region. When the gods opened their eyes, the area and the city mysteriously disappeared, as if they had never existed. "
The conversation became fainter and fainter. Under the early sun, among the figures traveling far away, the young man was silent, listening silently, and walking silently.
The further you go, the farther you go.
